title: Mario Golf: Super Rush books its tee time
body: Mario Golf: Super Rush tees off on OpenPak's shared NEX host. It builds, starts and serves its health endpoint, and because Golf is a peer-to-peer title the server's job is precise: log your console in, keep the lobby list honest and hand players to each other. That handshake has not met a console yet — the tee time is booked, and the swing needs proof.
